subject.title: Feature: Expose  tool (react action) to agent by default when reactionLevel allows it

question: Should Telegram reaction configuration automatically expose the existing broad `message` tool, or should OpenClaw add a narrower reaction-only/default-safe tool surface?
rationale: The source shows the reaction runtime exists, but changing default agent-visible mutating channel authority affects security and channel-control boundaries beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Add narrow reaction surface
options.body: Expose only reaction capability by default when Telegram reaction gates allow it, preserving broad `message` as an explicit policy/tool choice.

options.title: Auto-allow message tool
options.body: Make the existing `message` tool default-visible under reaction-enabled Telegram sessions, accepting the broader mutating action surface.

options.title: Clarify docs only
options.body: Document that `message` must be explicitly allowed or delivered via message-tool-only mode, leaving default tool exposure unchanged.

recommendation.title: Add narrow reaction surface
recommendation.body: Expose only reaction capability by default when Telegram reaction gates allow it, preserving broad `message` as an explicit policy/tool choice.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the strongest current cross-cutting owner signal across agent-tool exposure, Telegram reactions, and docs history.
